items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: Freddy Williamson, who was second to Joe Glaser.

ctx.x: As a soloist. And then I got an offer from an agent who -- Freddy Williamson, who was second to Joe Glaser. But at that time he was working for another agency in New York.

And somehow, he had given me a few things to do at DownBeat. We had met and he had given me a few things. And he called me and asked me if I'd like to take a band into the Childe's Fifth Avenue, 103rd and Broadway. And he said, --
